matrix_transpose.name: matrix_transpose
matrix_transpose.correct_code:
def matrix_transpose(matrix):
    if not matrix:
        return []
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    result = [[matrix[r][c] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(cols)]
    return result

compatible_bugs.original_code: result = [[matrix[r][c] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(cols)]
compatible_bugs.buggy_code: result = [[matrix[c][r] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(cols)]
compatible_bugs.explanation: Indices swapped, breaks non-square matrices
Off-by-one drops last column
